snippet.title: FlyKnight Trailer (gamejam version)
snippet.description:
FlyKnight is a small game I made for a gamejam in two weeks during my vacation, the theme was "Bugs" and my goal was to make a Kings Field inspired first person game with heavy combat, a slow character and a focus on Stamina management and combat strategy. 
Also I wanted to make it with Runescape graphics because they have soul and seemed fun to reproduce.

You can play it for free in here https://wabbaboy.itch.io/flyknight

CREDITS
Music by Michi https://michivgc.carrd.co/
3D Models by Squareanon https://squareanon.carrd.co/
Main development: Miguel Arroyo (Wabbaboy) https://twitter.com/Wabbaboy
